'''Neutrino grenades''' were explosives utilized by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] hallucinated that [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] was killed by one in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].
